newsitem.title: USA: Anadarko has Algerian new field find.
newsitem.headline: Anadarko has Algerian new field find.

text.p: Anadarko Petroleum Corp said Monday the Hassi Berkine South East No. 1 (HBNSE-1), a field discovery well on Block 404 in Algeria's Sahara Desert flowed 17,092 barrels of 47.6 degree gravity oil and 37.5 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.

HBNSE-1 well was started on May 1 and drilled to a total depth of 3,310 meters (10,856 feet), encountering 14 meters (46 feet) of net oil pay. Well results are being studied partners and delineation drilling is under evaluation, Anadarko said.

The company's interest in the well is 50 percent before participation at the exploitation phase by SONATRACH. Anadarko's two partners are LASMO Plc and the A.P. Moeller Group's Maersk Olie Algeriet AS.

HBNSE-1 discovery was announced July 10 when Anadarko said testing was underway. The well is located about 7.5 kilometers (4.5 miles) southeast of the HBNS-1b well, which was the discovery well for the HBNS Field in March 1995.
The HBNSE-1 well is located within 10 kilometers (6.2 miles) of the production facilities being built for the HBNS Field, Anadarko noted.
